decision_rules.ACCEPTED: Actual CPU/NPU trace execution, all relevant P/D rank coverage, source identity and count/cache/lifecycle correct; intervals discriminate at least one competing mechanism. This only accepts diagnostic information, not service optimization.
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Trace gap, pending worker profiler, barrier/stop failure, insufficient rank coverage, or no discriminating spans; preserve errors and restore owned profiler state.
